source_title: '20 villas in Udaipur, 8 in Alwar': Why IAS officer, IPS wife face ACB probe
source_excerpt: JAIPUR: The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) Friday registered a preliminary inquiry against senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal for allegedly misusing his official position to favour a private company and causing financial losses to the state govt.The state govt formally approved of an investigation against Agrawal earlier in the day.
